title: Go Out in Style
summary: Down but not out of frame. Ragdoll your way into the next life, on screen. Every death captured from a new dramatic camera angle. This update is setting up for something else big. What that is? You'll have to wait and see.
highlights: Your body ragdolls where you fall, in your skin and gear
Arrows and blasts send your body flying
New death camera angles: around your body, your killer and the mob you fought, then out from the carriage as it leaves
The scene ends with a look up at the sky. Left or Right changes the view, Space continues
Your loot drops exactly as before. The body holds nothing and goes when you respawn
Needs Sable: Ragdolls, which the CurseForge and Modrinth apps install for you

title.zh: 地牢列车 更新：华丽谢幕 | 我的世界模组
title.en: Dungeon Train Update: Go Out in Style | Minecraft Mod

description.zh:
倒下了，但没出镜。化作布娃娃，体面地迈向下一段人生。每一次死亡，都用全新的戏剧性镜头记录下来。这次更新还在为另一件大事做准备。是什么？敬请期待。

更新亮点：
· 身体在你倒下的地方化作布娃娃
· 被箭射中或被爆炸炸死时，身体会被击飞
· 全新死亡镜头：环绕你的身体、击杀你的生物和你战斗过的怪物，再从远去的车厢拉远
· 最后抬头望向天空；左右键切换视角，空格继续
· 掉落物与以前完全相同；身体不携带任何物品，重生后消失

完整更新说明：dungeon.training/update
下载：在 CurseForge 或 Modrinth 搜索 Dungeon Train（需要 Sable: Ragdolls，启动器会自动安装）
地牢列车是一个 Minecraft（我的世界）NeoForge 1.21.1 模组：在一列永不停歇的列车上冒险、搜刮、生存。
